response.text: {"verdict": "covered", "clause_ids": ["A4.1"], "rationale": "The claim involves medical treatment for an ankle sprain sustained during a trip. Clause A4.1 covers medical expenses for acute illness or injury during travel. There is no indication of pre-existing conditions (A5.1), planned treatment (A5.2), intentional injury (A11.1), alcohol or drug influence (A11.2), or events related to war, terrorism, or nuclear incidents (A11.4). Additionally, the injury did not occur during an extreme sport, and the policy explicitly includes extreme sports (A11.3)."}
